meta.title: 블록 마을
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from source/BRIEF.md (블록 마을, a summer coding camp for children (fictional)). Every decision below follows the brief and the style it names; nothing is a preset.

source.notes: 블록 마을, a summer coding camp for children (fictional)
Korean OFL fonts, cut to the characters the reel shows

rationale.palette: A toy world: sky blue #7FCBFF to #DDF3FF, grass #7CCB4F over dirt #A06C3E, sand #F2D27A, water #52BDF2, orange bricks #F08A5D, a red roof #EF4B3C, wood, two greens for leaves, lamp yellow #FFD84A; the code panel deep navy #1F2347 with candy syntax colours. Night turns everything towards #1A2456 except what glows.
rationale.type: Jua throughout, round and friendly: the name in white with a navy block extrusion, its letters dropping like blocks; the code in Jua too, coloured by token.
rationale.motion: Everything lands: tiles pop up from the middle out, blocks fall with a shadow growing under them, bounce once, squash and throw a puff; text pops with a small overshoot; each line of code flashes when it runs, a beat before its block lands.
rationale.sound: Bright pop at 128 BPM in G major (8 bars in 15 s, 16 in 30 s), marimba, pluck and bell on a full kit; pops on each landing, a riser into the loop, chimes for the night and the golden block.
rationale.visuals: All code: an isometric voxel renderer on Canvas2D (three shaded faces per cube, outlines, culling against neighbours, back-to-front order), a code panel that types, block clouds, stars and fireflies.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: the code on screen is the story.
